note: State executive orders are numbered by year (`Executive Order 2020-01`, `Exec. Order No. 2020-01D`); federal ones never carry a dash suffix. The pattern consumes an optional `-NN` suffix and `reject` drops any match that has one, so a state order never matches here, with or without `No.` (lcr-g). base_confidence stays 0.9 for the unsuffixed federal form.
